messages:
Alina: Drafted the relnotes for today's docs push. Two key callouts: model-pinning default change and new quantization recommendation table. Need copy-check and snippet sweep.
Marco: Where's the draft?
Alina: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/branches/relnotes-2718000456
Diego: Scanning  found the Go SDK example still uses the old Client constructor. New pattern is `redwood.NewClient(ctx, opts...)`. We should include both old->new migration lines.
Priya: Can you paste the updated Go snippet here for copy-paste?
Diego: Sure: ```go
import "github.com/redwood/sdk"
ctx := context.Background()
client, _ := redwood.NewClient(ctx, redwood.WithAPIKey(os.Getenv("REDWOOD_KEY")))
```
Sasha: For the model-pinning change: product decided to flip the default to "auto" model pinning for Hosted customers, but Dedicated stays "strict". We need a clear bullet and config example for Dedicated users to opt-in to auto.
Alina: Drafted this under "Deployment note": "Hosted now defaults to model_pinning=auto (improves fallbacks); Dedicated remains model_pinning=strict. Dedicated customers may opt into auto via their config or Redwood Console."
Marco: Add the exact config snippet so platform engineers can copy it.
Alina: Added: ```yaml
# Dedicated opt-in to auto model pinning
serving:
  routing:
    model_pinning: auto
```
Priya: Quantization table looks good but can we also add a suggested profile per workload? e.g., gen-short -> q4_0, long-context -> q8_0. UX wants explicit recs.
Alina: Done, added a small table and a one-line sentence: "See Optimize > Quantization for full tests."
Sasha: Marketing wants "preview (opt-in)" language for the feature flag we're calling "fallback-routing". Use that exact phrasing.
Alina: Updated language to "fallback-routing (preview - opt-in)".
Marco: Link-check: ran locally, two broken links: `/guides/quantize` and `/sdk/go-auth`. Docs Bot, can you run the branch sweep?
Docs Bot: Link-check queued for branch relnotes-2718000456  results in ~2m :gear:
Diego: I also flagged a small typo in the changelog bullet about "cost per token" (should be "cost-per-token metric").
Priya: Good catch  fixed.
Alina: Small ask from support: include a short troubleshooting blurb for embeddings regression after quantize changes. Engineering suggests a temporary mitigation: pin model to non-quantized variant. Include repro steps.
Diego: Repro (embed noise after q4_0): ```bash
# reproduce locally
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeds -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"input":"test"}'
# compare results with model:open-default vs model:open-noquant
```
Sasha: Please add internal tracker link internal/issue/9022 for follow-up and mark as "temporary workaround".
Alina: Added both the repro and tracker.
Docs Bot: Link-check complete: `/guides/quantize` -> 404, `/sdk/go-auth` -> 410. Suggest redirect `/guides/quantize` -> `/optimize/quantization`.
Marco: I'll open the redirect PR and the Go snippet patch. PRs: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/5311 and /pull/5312
Priya: One more tiny thing: add a short changelog bullet for "SDK: Go constructor change" so users scanning the top bullets see it.
Alina: Added bullet: "Go SDK: constructor updated to NewClient - see migration guide."
Sasha: Marketing sign-off pending but okay with the tone. Once link-check is green we can merge and schedule publish.
Alina: Plan: Marco merges redirect + snippet PRs, Docs Bot re-checks links, I do a final pass and ping marketing. Target: publish by 18:00 PT.
Marco: On it.
Docs Bot: Re-run link-check queued.
Alina: Thanks everyone  ping here for quick edits. :sparkles:
